alpha: Green chroma dominance > 64.0; reviewed local matte and steel pinhole edits are recorded in pixel-corrections.json. Other retained video RGB is unchanged. Clip start and end sources are recorded per frame; every clip ends at the original idle.

source_parts.playback: reverse: controlled lowering source is sampled backward as a direct point lift

model: Local MiniMax H3 int8; 28 steps; acceleration LoRA disabled

motion_correction.method: Re-generated middle preparation, continuous horizontal cut and compact recovery with aligned shoulders/pelvis and unchanged support-foot order. High/low pose pixels and timing remain v11.
motion_correction.source_review: v12 middle waist correction: stable shallow three-quarter torso, aligned shoulder/pelvis facing, same support-foot order and small knee-led loading. Continuous waist-level edge cut uses solid perspective poses; direct front-point lift is sampled backward from a controlled lowering take, then joins the original return take at its matching raised pose 22 and settles to idle. No source-frame body repainting or per-frame recentering. Retains v11 391/96/48/462 ms rhythm; high/low unchanged.

reference_design.character: Eula official movement rhythm as a balance and step reference, adapted to this same young fox swordswoman with continuous two-handed grip.
reference_design.high: Monster Hunter greatsword weight: rear-hip loading, torso-led overhead cut, front-knee catch and deliberate lift to guard.
reference_design.low: Wapenkunst rules 4-5: elbow-led hilt retraction and stable point-forward thrust; rear-foot drive, then recovery along the same line.
reference_design.mid: Horizontal edge cut with a stable shallow three-quarter view: aligned shoulders and pelvis, small knee-led weight transfer and a compact front-point recovery. No independent waist counter-rotation.

retiming.method: High and low keep their selected v10 poses and v11 timing. Middle uses the separately documented v12 motion correction.

timing: Source-part index lists define playback order, including any explicitly reversed recovery segment. Authored windup and contact holds preserve the fast release. Rejected source frames are listed in production.json.
weapon_attack_effects: Removed: animation-only attacks; stance-switch effects remain separate.
